period.label: Month 2 — Convert the audience we built

rationale: Month 1 proved the machine PRODUCES (39 reels, 29 shorts, 128 articles, ~1,250 social posts) and that production alone does not convert: 9 FB followers, 8 lifetime engagement actions, 7 email subs flat for two weeks, 0 YouTube subs off 29 shorts. Month 2 targets are rebuilt from REAL 14-day pace, not ambition — every number below is cumulative (the counters are lifetime, not per-period). Production targets stay aggressive because they cost nothing; audience targets are cut to honest multiples of actual pace so the dashboard tells the truth instead of showing 1%. The one place we deliberately under-set is ad video views: the $7/day campaign is PAUSED, so that number cannot move until Aaron resumes it. Recalibrated 2026-07-27 (weekly strategist).

targets.label: Reels shipped
targets.note: 39 done. ~1/day is the real sustained rate — fresh-render queue needs refilling monthly.

targets.label: YouTube Shorts
targets.note: 29 done. Slipped to ~0.3/day in July; 45 is a realistic push, not the old 1/day fiction.

targets.label: Posts shipped
targets.note: 42 done, publisher runs 2/day reliably. This one is on rails.

targets.label: Ad video views
targets.note: 16,704 lifetime at $0.006/view — but the $7/day campaign is PAUSED, so this is frozen. Resuming for 30 days would add ~35k. AARON'S CALL: budget stays at/below $10/day per guardrail.

targets.label: FB engagement
targets.note: 8 lifetime. Cut 800→60. Reach isn't the problem (44.9k); nobody is being ASKED anything. Reply-first + real questions is the lever.

targets.label: YouTube views
targets.note: 1,145 and growing ~3/day. Cut 10,000→1,400 — the honest number until Shorts get titles/hooks built for search.

targets.label: FB followers
targets.note: 9 FB followers, ~2/week organic. 25 assumes the paused retarget→follow campaign gets switched on; without it, ~17.

targets.label: YouTube subs
targets.note: 0 subs off 29 shorts. Nobody asks. 10 = proof the ask works, not a growth target.

targets.label: Instagram followers
targets.note: 0 followers off 356 media items — IG is publishing into a void. 25 = proof the account is actually discoverable.

targets.label: Email subscribers
targets.note: 7, flat since 2026-07-13. The capture block is on every article; the funnel is the failure, not the traffic.

targets.note: Tracks followers. Comes from the retarget campaign, if it's resumed.
